about: Ready-made plans for the trip's free time (Jordan, 2026-10-08). Every place named here is a row in research/playground.json: open the row for hours, cost, phone, website and a Google Maps link, and for whether the hours were quoted off a page that day or are unconfirmed. Drive times are from Vogel. Nothing is booked; these are so nobody has to plan on the spot.

plans.title: Arrival afternoon: pick one walk, then stars
plans.summary: Arrive 1 PM, set camp, then ONE short walk of three (Jordan, 2026-10-08: any of them is fine, pick on the day) — Helton Creek Falls, DeSoto Falls or Sosebee Cove. Back for dinner, then up to Brasstown Bald after dark.

steps.what: Arrive Vogel, check in, haul gear to walk-in site P
Set up base camp — tents, food hang, kitchen

PICK ONE: Helton Creek Falls (13 min, 0.13 mi of steps and boardwalk, a lower and an upper falls) / DeSoto Falls (about 10 min, open 24 h, two falls off one easy loop) / Sosebee Cove Scenic Area (about 10 min, old-growth cove, short loop, free)
Dinner at camp (sunset 7:02 PM, fully dark 7:26 PM)
Drive up to Brasstown Bald for the stars, 27 min. Warm layers, red headlamps, chairs. After-hours fee $6 per adult.

swaps.what: Mountain Crossings at Neel Gap — 7 min, closes 5 PM. The AT outfitter in the stone building the trail runs through; good for a forgotten bit of gear

closed.what: Trahlyta Falls and the Lake Trahlyta Loop Trail inside Vogel are CLOSED — the lake is drained for dam repairs (park page, re-fetched 2026-10-08)

plans.when: Mon Oct 19, evening (back off the hike)
plans.title: Off the hike: shower, then the biggest dinner of the trip
plans.summary: The group walks out to Owltown Gap Monday afternoon and is back at Vogel by about 5 PM. Low effort on purpose: showers, then either cook the big base-camp dinner or drive 10 min for barbecue.

steps.what: Both trucks back at Vogel. Showers, dry everything out, sort the pans and the concentrates
Option A (recommended): cook the big dinner at camp — this is the meal MASTER_LIST sizes as the trip's large one
Option B: Jim's Smokin' Que, 10 min, open 7 days 11 AM–8 PM — closest real food to the park
Final pan-out at camp: the shared concentrates bucket, a tub, a headlamp and the snuffer bottles

swaps.what: Hole in the Wall, 16 min, Tue–Sat to 8 PM (Mon closes 2 PM — check before driving)
Sunrise Grocery, 7 min, closes 7 PM — ice, firewood, boiled peanuts on the way back in

plans.title: Tuesday A: the waterfall run (recommended)
plans.summary: The free day's best use of a truck: three or four waterfalls, all drive-up with short walks, finishing in Helen. Everything on this list was open year-round when checked on 2026-10-08.

steps.what: DeSoto Falls — 10 min. Three falls off one easy loop, open 24 h
Raven Cliff Falls — 29 min. Longer walk in (the trail follows the creek past several drops)
Dukes Creek Falls — 40 min, day use only. Big one, good path
Anna Ruby Falls — 56 min. Closes 5 PM and no admission after 4, so this is the one to drop if the day runs late
Helen for dinner — 42 min from Vogel. Oktoberfest runs nightly Oct 1 – Nov 1 at the Festhalle (door times unconfirmed)

swaps.what: High Shoals Falls and Blue Hole Falls — 33 min, two falls on one trail (hours unconfirmed)
Helton Creek Falls if Thursday got rained out — 13 min

plans.title: Tuesday B: the gold day in Dahlonega
plans.summary: For anyone who wants more gold than the hike produced, with a guaranteed-colour flume as the backstop. Gold Rush Days (Oct 17–18) is over by Tuesday, so the square is normal again.

steps.what: Crisson Gold Mine — 34 min. Outdoor flume panning and gem sifting, colour in every bucket
Lunch on the Dahlonega square
Dahlonega Gold Museum — in the old courthouse on the square, Mon–Sat 9 AM–4:45 PM
Dukes Creek Gold and Ruby Mines — 38 min, open April through October with limited hours; call first

swaps.what: Consolidated Gold Mine again if the Friday tour was the highlight — underground, 38 min
Wolf Mountain Vineyards — 34 min, tasting room Thu–Sun 11 AM–5 PM (closed Tuesday — do not drive out)

plans.title: Tuesday C: the local day (short drives, resupply, the high points)
plans.summary: Lowest effort. Tuesday is the Union County Farmers Market's morning, the Blairsville square is 16 min away, and Brasstown Bald in daylight is a different thing from Brasstown Bald at night.

steps.what: Union County Farmers Market — 18 min. Tuesday 9 AM–1 PM is one of its two market days (hours unconfirmed)
Blairsville town square and the Union County Old Courthouse Museum — 16–17 min, museum Mon–Fri 10 AM–4 PM
Resupply: Ingles Blairsville (7 AM–11 PM) or Walmart Supercenter (6 AM–11 PM), plus gas
Brasstown Bald in daylight — 30 min, site 10 AM–5 PM. Shuttle, or the steep 0.6 mi paved walk
Bell Mountain — 45 min, 8 AM to dark. Drive to the top, painted rock, big view over Lake Chatuge

swaps.what: Meeks Park in Blairsville — 19 min, walking paths by the river. Note: Sorghum in the Mountains runs Oct 10–18, so it is finished by Tuesday
Lake Nottely, Poteete Creek Park beach — 41 min (hours unconfirmed)

closed.what: Lake Winfield Scott: campground, beach and pavilion are closed (site partially closed, checked 2026-10-08)

plans.title: Pack-out morning, with one last stop
plans.summary: The site must be clear by noon. Break camp first, then pick one short stop on the way out — nothing that needs a reservation or a long drive.

steps.what: Breakfast, then break camp: Leave No Trace sweep, load trucks
Out of site P. Settle anything at the office
Pick one: Sunrise Grocery (7 min, opens 7:30) for boiled peanuts and jerky for the drive
Or Mountain Crossings at Neel Gap (7 min, opens 9 AM) — the outfitter the AT runs through
Or a last pan at Yahoola Creek Park in Dahlonega if the route home passes that way — free public panning, no detour if it is on the way

swaps.what: Byron Herbert Reece Farm and Heritage Center — 6 min, visitor centre Wed–Sat 10 AM–4 PM April through October (unconfirmed for late October)

plans.title: Rain plan: indoors, and nothing above 2,500 ft
plans.summary: Two rules on a wet day: no ridge, no creek. The ground plan is Dahlonega, which is indoor-heavy and the one place the trip already knows. If the rain lands on a hike day, the hike shortens — do not camp in a narrow headwater drainage in a flash-flood watch.

steps.what: Consolidated Gold Mine — 38 min. The tour is underground, so rain is irrelevant. This is already the Friday plan; doing it twice is fine
Lunch on the Dahlonega square — covered sidewalks all round it
Dahlonega Gold Museum — indoor, Mon–Sat 9 AM–4:45 PM
Union County Old Courthouse Museum in Blairsville — 17 min, Mon–Fri 10 AM–4 PM, Sat 11 AM–3 PM
Helen — 42 min. Indoor shops and the Festhalle (Oktoberfest nightly Oct 1 – Nov 1)
Stay in: the 10x10 canopy over the kitchen, cards, and the pan-out tub. Jim's Smokin' Que is 10 min for food

swaps.what: Hardman Farm State Historic Site — 40 min, guided house tour, 7 days 10 AM–4 PM, last tour 3 PM
Ingles Pharmacy or The Home Depot Blairsville — 17 min, for whatever the weather broke

warnings: Flash flood in a narrow headwater: CAMP-U is about one creek-mile below the source. In a watch, do not camp there — shorten the hike or stay at WOLF-X and drive back to Vogel.
Campfire restrictions on the Chattahoochee-Oconee were lifted May 4, 2026 (USFS alerts page, 2026-10-08), but status can change — re-check with Blue Ridge RD 706-745-6928 before the trip.
